title: Why 20, Not 10? Permutations Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
Five friends, two badges: captain and vice captain. Most people guess 10 ways to hand them out. The real answer is 20. Why? Because the two badges are different, and when order matters we count permutations. This animated lesson follows NCERT Chapter 6, Permutations and Combinations (Class 11).

You will watch a live 5 x 5 grid count every captain and vice captain pair, cross out the impossible ones and land on 20. Then we fill places one by one to build the formula nPr = n(n-1)(n-2)...(n-r+1), watch the count grow as we add one place at a time, and rewrite it with factorials as nPr = n! / (n-r)!. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example with 8 runners and 3 medals, the exam trap of n to the power r, an original JEE Main pattern question on making even numbers from digits, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.
